entries.en: A delayed shipment of acetomycin forced the laboratory to postpone its comparison.
entries.zh: 醋霉素的一批货延迟到达，迫使实验室推迟了比较工作。

entries.en: The physician wanted the old blood-test results before discussing the suspected acetonaemia.
entries.zh: 医生想先拿到以前的血液检查结果，再讨论疑似的丙酮血症。

entries.en: An unlabeled photograph could not establish which sample contained acetonaphthalide.
entries.zh: 一张没有标注的照片无法确定哪个样品含有乙酰萘胺。

entries.en: The research team compared two accounts of the analysis of acetonaphtone.
entries.zh: 研究团队比较了两份关于萘乙酮分析工作的记述。

entries.en: Acetonation was the only unfinished stage when the funding was withdrawn.
entries.zh: 经费被撤回时，丙酮化作用是唯一尚未完成的阶段。

entries.en: The historical exhibit included an empty bottle that had once held acetone-chloroform.
entries.zh: 那场历史展览展出了一只曾装过丙酮氯仿的空瓶。

entries.en: The drawings survived, but the measurements made after acetonization were missing.
entries.zh: 图纸保存了下来，但丙酮化作用之后取得的测量数据不见了。

entries.en: The apothecary ordered acetonum for the workshop, but the delivery never arrived.
entries.zh: 药剂师为作坊订购了丙酮，但订购的货物始终没有送到。

entries.meaningZh: 尿丙酮定量器〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The museum postponed photographing its acetonumerator until the broken display case was replaced.
entries.zh: 博物馆把馆藏尿丙酮定量器的拍摄工作推迟到破损展柜更换之后。

entries.en: The acetonylacetone measurements were excluded because nobody could identify the person who recorded them.
entries.zh: 那些2,5-己二酮测量数据被排除了，因为没有人能确定记录者是谁。

entries.en: Her comparison of acetonylamine samples ended when the instrument failed.
entries.zh: 仪器发生故障，她对丙酮基胺样品的比较也就中止了。

entries.en: A duplicate invoice caused the purchase of acetophenazine to be counted twice.
entries.zh: 一张重复发票使那笔乙酰奋乃静采购被计算了两次。

entries.en: The pharmacist discovered that the acetophenetide order had gone to the wrong address.
entries.zh: 药剂师发现，乙酰氧乙苯胺的订购单被送到了错误的地址。

entries.en: No acetophenetidide remained for the second comparison, so the results were left provisional.
entries.zh: 没有剩余的乙酰氧乙苯胺可用于第二次比较，因此结果仍被视为暂定。

entries.en: The archive contained correspondence about a disputed delivery of acetophenetidine.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着关于一批有争议的非那西汀交货的往来信件。

entries.en: They needed another spectrum before accepting the proposed identification of acetophenone.
entries.zh: 他们需要再看一份光谱，才能接受所提出的苯乙酮鉴定结论。

entries.meaningZh: 苯乙酮缩非那替汀〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The disputed container of acetophenone-p-phenetidine was excluded from the donated historical collection.
entries.zh: 那个存有苯乙酮缩非那替汀且存在争议的容器未被纳入捐赠的历史藏品。

entries.en: The old pharmacy's surviving accounts show that its acetopyrine was supplied by two firms.
entries.zh: 那家老药房留存的账目表明，其乙酰比林由两家公司供应。

entries.en: The missing comparison data weakened her argument about the acetopyrrothin samples.
entries.zh: 比较数据的缺失削弱了她关于那些乙二硫吡咯菌素样品的论证。

entries.en: A spilled drink ruined the notebook containing the acetorthotoluid measurements.
entries.zh: 一杯饮料洒了出来，毁掉了记有邻乙酰氨基甲苯测量数据的笔记本。

entries.en: Only the acetosoluble fraction was included in the comparison shown on the next page.
entries.zh: 下一页展示的比较只纳入了可溶于醋酸的部分。

entries.en: The team disagreed about whether the recovered material contained acetostearin.
entries.zh: 团队成员对于回收的材料是否含有乙酰硬脂酸甘油酯存在分歧。

entries.en: The original spectrum of acetotoluide was clearer than the faded copy in the archive.
entries.zh: N-乙酰甲苯胺的原始光谱比档案中褪色的副本清楚。

entries.en: The courier returned the acetoxolone shipment after discovering an error in the destination address.
entries.zh: 快递员发现目的地地址有误后，退回了那批甘草次酸醋酸酯。

entries.en: A damaged invoice left the quantity of Acetoxon in the cancelled order uncertain.
entries.zh: 一张破损的发票使已取消订单中乙酯磷的数量无法确定。

entries.en: She drew the acetoxy group separately because the crowded diagram was hard to follow.
entries.zh: 由于原图过于拥挤、难以看清，她把乙酰氧基单独画了出来。

entries.en: The discussion turned to the acetoxyl group that distinguished the two proposed structures.
entries.zh: 讨论转向了使那两个拟议结构有所区别的乙酰氧基。

entries.en: A torn notebook page interrupted his reconstruction of the acetoxylide analysis.
entries.zh: 笔记本中一页的破损打断了他对2,4-二甲基乙酰苯胺分析工作的重建。

entries.en: The collaboration on acetoxypregnenolone ended before either group had checked the other's measurements.
entries.zh: 双方关于乙酸基孕烯醇酮的合作结束时，两组都还没有核查对方的测量数据。

entries.en: The invoice for acetparatoluid was returned unsigned because the quoted amount was disputed.
entries.zh: 由于报价金额存在争议，那张对乙酰氨基甲苯发票未经签字就被退回了。

entries.en: Her reconstruction of the acetphenetide purchase depended on a letter found inside a ledger.
entries.zh: 她对那笔N-乙酰乙氧苯胺采购的重建，依靠的是账簿里发现的一封信。

entries.en: The historian could not determine whether the acetphenetidide had actually reached the pharmacy.
entries.zh: 历史学者无法确定那批乙酰氨基苯乙醚是否真的送到了药房。

entries.en: Several pages of the study survived, but its final analysis of acetphenetidine did not.
entries.zh: 那项研究留下了几页材料，但关于N-乙酰乙氧基苯胺的最终分析没有保存下来。

entries.en: The planned purchase of acetpyrogall was cancelled before any money changed hands.
entries.zh: 拟议的乙酰没食子酚采购，在任何款项支付之前就取消了。

entries.meaningZh: 乙酰氨基三碘苯甲酸盐
entries.en: The acetrizoate results could not be compared until the two laboratories reconciled their records.
entries.zh: 两家实验室核对好记录之后，才能比较有关乙酰氨基三碘苯甲酸盐的结果。

entries.en: The disagreement over acettoluide began with a misplaced decimal point in the report.
entries.zh: 关于N-乙酰甲苯胺的争议，起因是报告中的一个小数点位置写错了。

entries.meaningZh: 乙酰化羊毛脂醇〔Acetulan商品名〕
entries.en: The proposed purchase of Acetulan was postponed because the department had not approved the budget.
entries.zh: 由于部门尚未批准预算，拟议的Acetulan乙酰化羊毛脂醇采购被推迟了。

entries.en: The proposed structure of acetyl-anisidine remained under discussion after the meeting ended.
entries.zh: 会议结束后，N-乙酰茴香胺的拟议结构仍在讨论之中。

entries.en: A missing signature delayed payment for the acetyl-beta-methylcholine supplied to the research department.
entries.zh: 缺少一个签名，导致向研究部门供应乙酰-β-甲胆硷的货款延迟支付。

entries.en: The students' calculations for acetyl-isobutyryl did not agree with the figures on the handout.
entries.zh: 学生们关于2,3-异己二酮的计算结果与讲义中的数字不一致。

entries.en: The notebook containing the acetyl-isovaleryl comparison was recovered from a box of unrelated papers.
entries.zh: 记有2,3-异庚二酮比较结果的笔记本，从一箱无关文件中被找了出来。

entries.en: The research budget included acetyl-l-carnitine, but the purchasing office requested a clearer justification.
entries.zh: 研究预算列入了乙酰左旋肉碱，但采购部门要求提供更明确的理由。

entries.en: Her work on acetyl-propionyl paused while the department replaced the damaged instrument.
entries.zh: 部门更换损坏仪器期间，她关于2,3-戊二酮的工作暂停了。

entries.en: The lecturer left the structure of acetyl-resorcin unfinished and invited the class to correct it.
entries.zh: 讲师没有画完间苯二酚一乙酸酯的结构，而是请全班同学来修改。

entries.en: An acetylacetate from the comparison set was omitted from the final inventory.
entries.zh: 最终清单漏记了比较组中的一种乙酰醋酸盐。

entries.en: The discussion of acetyladenylate continued in the corridor after the seminar room closed.
entries.zh: 研讨室关闭后，关于乙酰腺苷酸的讨论还在走廊里继续。

entries.en: A second reviewer questioned the identification of acetylanthranil in the disputed material.
entries.zh: 第二位审阅者质疑了将争议材料鉴定为含有乙酰氨茴内酐的结论。

entries.en: The researchers disagreed about how much acetylase activity the surviving records could establish.
entries.zh: 研究人员对于留存记录能证实多少乙酰基转移酶活性存在分歧。

entries.en: The replacement acetylator could not fit through the laboratory's narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 那台替换用的乙酰化器无法通过实验室狭窄的门口。

entries.en: The museum declined the donation of acetylatoxyl but accepted the accompanying correspondence.
entries.zh: 博物馆拒收了捐赠的阿撤西丁，但收下了随附的往来信件。

entries.en: An unexplained difference between the acetylbenzene measurements prompted a review of the original files.
entries.zh: 苯乙酮测量数据之间存在无法解释的差异，促使人们重新核查原始文件。

entries.en: The molecular model of acetylbenzoyl was missing when the seminar began.
entries.zh: 研讨会开始时，乙酰苯酰的分子模型不见了。

entries.en: The cancelled project left no complete account of the proposed acetylbenzoyl-peroxide comparison.
entries.zh: 项目取消后，拟议的过氧化乙酰苯甲酰比较工作没有留下完整记述。

entries.en: The student had to redraw acetylcarbamide after noticing an error in the original diagram.
entries.zh: 学生发现原图有误后，不得不重画乙酰碳酰二胺的结构。

entries.en: The two groups could not reconcile their estimates of acetylcholinesterase activity.
entries.zh: 两组无法统一各自对乙酰胆碱酯酶活性的估计。

entries.en: Her unfinished paper compared several published measurements of acetylcysteine without recommending its use.
entries.zh: 她尚未完成的论文比较了几份已发表的乙酰半胱氨酸测量数据，但没有建议使用它。

entries.en: The old ledger records a refund for acetyldigitoxin that never reached its intended destination.
entries.zh: 旧账簿记载了一笔乙酰洋地黄毒甙退款，那批货始终没有送达预定目的地。

entries.en: The study's conclusions about acetyldigitoxins were challenged because several comparison records were missing.
entries.zh: 由于缺少几份比较记录，那项研究关于乙酰洋地黄毒苷的结论受到质疑。

entries.en: The archive retained the correspondence concerning acetyldihydrocodeinone, not the substance itself.
entries.zh: 档案馆保留的是有关乙酰二氢可待因酮的往来信件，而不是这种物质本身。

entries.en: The proposed identification of acetylenedibromide was withdrawn after the original measurements were checked.
entries.zh: 核查原始测量数据后，所提出的对称二溴乙烯鉴定结论被撤回了。

entries.en: A missing page prevented the researchers from reconstructing the acetylenedicarboxamide comparison.
entries.zh: 缺失的一页材料使研究人员无法重建乙炔双碳酰胺的比较工作。

entries.en: The recovered records concerned acetylenedichloride rather than the material named in the summary.
entries.zh: 找回的记录涉及1,2-二氯乙烯，而不是摘要中所说的材料。

entries.en: An acetylenetetrahalide had been included in the comparison, but its measurements were not preserved.
entries.zh: 比较中曾纳入一种均四卤乙烷，但它的测量数据没有保存下来。

entries.en: The argument about acetylesterase activity continued after the disputed chart was removed.
entries.zh: 那张有争议的图表撤下后，关于乙酰酯酶活性的争论仍在继续。

entries.en: The missing acetylferrocene model was eventually found in a box belonging to another class.
entries.zh: 那个不见了的乙酰基二茂铁模型，最后在另一个班的箱子里被找到了。

entries.en: The supplier corrected the invoice after the laboratory disputed the quantity of acetylglycocoll delivered.
entries.zh: 实验室对交付的N-乙酰甘氨酸数量提出异议后，供应商更正了发票。

entries.meaningZh: 乙酰基高半胱氨酸硫内酯
entries.en: The incomplete measurements of acetylhomocysteinethiolactone were kept separate from the verified results.
entries.zh: 不完整的乙酰基高半胱氨酸硫内酯测量数据与已核实的结果分开保存。

entries.en: The committee postponed the proposed purchase of acetylhydroperoxide until the research plan was clarified.
entries.zh: 委员会把拟议的过醋酸采购推迟到研究计划明确之后。

entries.en: The student mistook an acetylide for a different compound in the molecular-model exercise.
entries.zh: 在分子模型练习中，学生把一种乙炔化物误认成了另一种化合物。

entries.en: The disputed analytical results for acetylmethyl-carbinol were discussed again when the missing notebook reappeared.
entries.zh: 丢失的笔记本再次出现后，那些有争议的乙酰甲基原醇分析结果又被拿来讨论。

entries.en: Her presentation on acetylmethylcarbinol ended early because the projector stopped working.
entries.zh: 投影仪停止工作，她关于乙偶姻的报告便提前结束了。

entries.en: The acetyloxyphenol comparison was abandoned when the two groups could not agree on the records.
entries.zh: 两组无法就记录达成一致，于是放弃了间苯二酚一乙酸酯的比较工作。

entries.en: The historical collection contained an invoice for acetylpheneturide but no corresponding delivery receipt.
entries.zh: 那批历史藏品中有一张乙酰苯丁酰脲发票，却没有相应的交货收据。

entries.en: A damaged recording left the debate about acetylphosphatase activity unresolved.
entries.zh: 一份录音受损，使关于乙酰磷酸酶活性的争论未能得到解决。

entries.en: The manuscript's account of acetylphosphate was revised after the original data were recovered.
entries.zh: 原始数据找回后，手稿中关于乙酰磷酸盐的记述作了修订。

entries.en: An acetylsalicylate was omitted from the comparison table because its identity remained disputed.
entries.zh: 一种乙酰水杨酸盐未被列入比较表，因为它的身份仍存在争议。

entries.meaningZh: 乙酰水杨酸的〔用于acetylsalicylic acid〕
entries.en: The acetylsalicylic acid measurements came from a notebook that had lost its cover.
entries.zh: 那些乙酰水杨酸测量数据来自一本封面已脱落的笔记本。

entries.en: The pharmacist's letter disputed the charge for acetylsalol rather than the cost of transport.
entries.zh: 药剂师在信中质疑的是乙酰水杨酸苯酯的收费，而不是运输费用。

entries.en: Her diagram of acetylshikonin had to be replaced because the printed version was illegible.
entries.zh: 印刷版本难以辨认，她的乙酰紫草根素结构图不得不更换。

entries.en: The clerk found two invoices for the same delivery of acetylspiramycin.
entries.zh: 职员发现，同一批交付的乙酰螺旋霉素有两张发票。

entries.en: The correspondence about acetylstrophanthidin was separated from the laboratory's financial records.
entries.zh: 有关乙酰毒毛旋花子甙原的往来信件与实验室的财务记录分开存放。

entries.en: The disputed identification of acetylsulfadiazine prompted a request for the original spectra.
entries.zh: 乙酰磺胺嘧啶的鉴定结论存在争议，因此有人要求查看原始光谱。

entries.en: The acetylsulfaguanidine project lost its funding before the comparison could be repeated.
entries.zh: 乙酰磺胺脒项目还没来得及重复比较工作，经费就被撤回了。

entries.en: The report on acetylsulfamethoxypyridazine arrived without the photographs needed to check its conclusions.
entries.zh: 关于乙酰磺胺甲氧嗪的报告送到了，却没有附上核查其结论所需的照片。

entries.en: A calculation error changed the reported quantity of acetylsulfathiazole, not the number of samples.
entries.zh: 一个计算错误改变了报告中的乙酰磺胺噻唑数量，却没有改变样品数目。

entries.en: The museum kept the empty acetyltannin container but rejected the unidentified material beside it.
entries.zh: 博物馆保留了那个乙酰鞣酸空容器，但拒收了旁边身份不明的材料。

entries.en: The reported increase in acetyltransferase activity could not be confirmed from the available records.
entries.zh: 根据现有记录，无法证实所报告的乙酰转移酶活性增加情况。

entries.en: The proposed structure of acetyltryptophan was reconsidered when a clearer copy of the drawing became available.
entries.zh: 取得更清楚的图纸副本后，人们重新考虑了N-乙酰色氨酸的拟议结构。

entries.meaningZh: 研究生医学教育鉴定委员会〔ACGME机构名〕
entries.en: Her correspondence with ACGME was filed separately from the university's internal meeting records.
entries.zh: 她与ACGME研究生医学教育鉴定委员会的往来信件，与大学内部会议记录分开归档。

entries.en: The illustration of an Achaemenian seal was too small for the students to examine together.
entries.zh: 那幅阿契美尼德人印章的插图太小，不便学生们一起仔细查看。

entries.en: The traveller in the historical novel returned to Achaia carrying a letter for an old friend.
entries.zh: 历史小说中的那位旅行者，带着一封给老友的信回到了亚该亚。

entries.en: Her appointment about suspected achalasia was moved to a room where she could hear more clearly.
entries.zh: 她因疑似弛缓不能安排的门诊，改到了一个能让她听得更清楚的房间。

entries.en: Throughout the failed expedition, Martin remained my Achates, never blaming me for our mistakes.
entries.zh: 在那次失败的探险中，马丁始终是我忠实的朋友，从未因我们的错误责怪我。

entries.en: The photographs of specimens of Achatina were returned because their identifying numbers had been mixed up.
entries.zh: 那些玛瑙螺属标本的照片被退回了，因为标识编号混淆了。

entries.en: The illustration of acheilia was returned to the artist because an essential view was missing.
entries.zh: 那幅无唇畸形插图被退还给画师，因为少了一个必要的视图。

entries.en: The acheilous fetus in the anatomical drawing was shown from two different angles.
entries.zh: 解剖图中那个无唇的胎儿以两个不同角度呈现。

entries.en: A damaged photograph prevented the illustrator from completing the plate of an acheilus.
entries.zh: 一张受损照片使插画师无法完成那幅无唇畸胎图版。

entries.en: The family requested a second consultation about the suspected acheiropodia before discussing any further plans.
entries.zh: 家属要求就疑似的无手足畸形再咨询一次，然后再讨论进一步的安排。

entries.en: The museum's acheirous fetal model remained unavailable while its supporting stand was repaired.
entries.zh: 支架维修期间，博物馆那件无手胎儿模型暂时无法使用。

entries.en: The old atlas showed an acheirus, but the surviving copy had lost the accompanying case history.
entries.zh: 旧图谱中画有一个无手畸胎，但留存的副本缺失了随附的病例记录。

entries.meaningZh: 阿刻罗俄斯〔希腊神话河神名〕
entries.en: The actor playing Achelous waited backstage while the broken scenery was repaired.
entries.zh: 扮演河神阿刻罗俄斯的演员在后台等候，损坏的布景正在维修。

entries.en: An achenium fell from the dried specimen when she lifted it from the paper.
entries.zh: 她从纸上拿起那份干燥标本时，一枚瘦果掉了下来。

entries.en: The proposed Acheulean attribution was questioned when the excavation records could not be found.
entries.zh: 找不到发掘记录后，所提出的阿舍利文化归属受到质疑。

entries.en: The Acheulian tool display was moved so that visitors could examine it without blocking the doorway.
entries.zh: 阿舍利文化工具的展品被挪了位置，让参观者能在不堵住门口的情况下仔细观看。

entries.en: We spent a rainy afternoon on Achill sorting photographs in the cottage.
entries.zh: 在阿基尔岛，我们在小屋里整理照片，度过了一个下雨的下午。

entries.en: The critic found the novel's Achillean hero more convincing in defeat than in triumph.
entries.zh: 评论家觉得，小说中那位阿喀琉斯式英雄在失败时比在获胜时更令人信服。

entries.en: The proposed comparison of achillein was postponed because one laboratory had lost its original files.
entries.zh: 由于一家实验室丢失了原始文件，拟议的洋蓍草素比较工作被推迟了。

entries.en: Her notes on achilleine survived the move, but the diagrams stored separately did not.
entries.zh: 搬迁后，她关于蓍草碱的笔记保存了下来，单独存放的图纸却没有。

entries.en: The patient asked for an interpreter before the consultation about possible achillorrhaphy began.
entries.zh: 在讨论是否进行跟腱缝术的咨询开始之前，患者要求安排口译员。

entries.en: The scheduled achillotomy was postponed after the patient requested more time to consider the proposal.
entries.zh: 患者要求更多时间考虑该方案后，原定的跟腱切断术被推迟了。

entries.en: The gardener moved the young achiote away from the entrance before repainting the gate.
entries.zh: 重新粉刷大门之前，园丁把那株小胭脂树移离了入口。

entries.en: The student had to explain why the model she had drawn was achiral.
entries.zh: 学生必须解释，为什么她画出的模型是非手性的。

entries.en: The model's claimed achirality became doubtful when a missing piece was discovered beneath the table.
entries.zh: 桌子下面发现了一个缺失的部件，使关于该模型非手性的判断变得可疑。

entries.en: The achiric fetus was shown in profile in the atlas's surviving illustration.
entries.zh: 图谱留存的插图以侧面呈现了那个无手的胎儿。

entries.en: The artist requested another photograph of the achirous specimen before finishing the anatomical plate.
entries.zh: 画师要求再提供一张无手标本的照片，然后再完成解剖图版。

entries.en: A sketch of an achirus was found between two unrelated pages of the damaged notebook.
entries.zh: 那本受损笔记本的两页无关内容之间，发现了一幅无手畸胎素描。

entries.en: The illustrator left Achitophel unfinished while deciding how to arrange the figures in the biblical scene.
entries.zh: 插画师还在考虑如何安排圣经场景中的人物，因此尚未完成亚希多弗的形象。

entries.en: The old collection's specimens of Achlea were unavailable when the illustrator arrived.
entries.zh: 插画师到达时，那批旧藏中的鱼真菌属标本暂时无法提供。

entries.en: Several achlorides were included in the comparison, but their measurements were missing from the report.
entries.zh: 比较中纳入了几种非氯化物，但报告中缺少它们的测量数据。

entries.en: The suspected achloroblepsia was discussed only after an interpreter had joined the consultation.
entries.zh: 口译员加入咨询后，才开始讨论疑似的绿色盲。

entries.meaningZh: 非绿色瘤性单核细胞瘤〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The archived case of suspected achloromonocytoma lacked the images needed for a second assessment.
entries.zh: 档案中那例疑似非绿色瘤性单核细胞瘤病例，缺少再次评估所需的图像。

entries.en: The consultant requested the earlier records before discussing the possibility of achloropsia.
entries.zh: 顾问医师要求先取得以前的记录，再讨论绿色盲的可能性。

entries.en: She wanted to discuss her achluophobia privately rather than in front of the whole family.
entries.zh: 她想私下谈谈自己对暗处的恐惧，而不愿当着全家人的面讨论。

entries.en: The description of an acholic sample was questioned because the original specimen was unavailable.
entries.zh: 原始标本无法提供，因此把某个样品描述为无胆汁的说法受到质疑。

entries.en: The old case notes suggested acholuria, but the supporting test records had been lost.
entries.zh: 旧病历提示可能存在无胆尿，但支持这一判断的检测记录已经丢失。

entries.meaningZh: 无胆色素尿的〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The surviving case summary described an acholuric patient without preserving the original test results.
entries.zh: 留存的病例摘要描述了一名无胆色素尿患者，但没有保留原始检测结果。

entries.en: The class compared two drawings of achordate animals without assigning either to a particular species.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两幅无脊索动物的图，但没有将图中的动物归入某个特定物种。

entries.en: The old teaching collection included specimens of Achorion that could no longer be matched to their records.
entries.zh: 那批旧教学藏品包含一些毛癣菌属标本，已无法与相应记录匹配。

entries.meaningZh: 红细胞中血红蛋白缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician questioned the recorded achreocythemia after discovering that two files had been exchanged.
entries.zh: 医生发现两份档案被调换后，对记录中的红细胞血红蛋白缺乏情况提出了质疑。

entries.en: The proposed account of achroglobin remained incomplete when the research group dissolved.
entries.zh: 研究小组解散时，拟写的关于消色球蛋白的记述仍未完成。

entries.meaningZh: 红细胞中血红蛋白缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The case of suspected achroicythemia was left unresolved because the original blood-test results were missing.
entries.zh: 由于缺少原始血液检查结果，那例疑似红细胞血红蛋白缺乏的病例没有得到明确结论。

entries.meaningZh: 红细胞中血红蛋白缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: A second opinion about the reported achroiocythemia was requested before the family meeting.
entries.zh: 家庭会谈之前，有人要求就报告中的红细胞血红蛋白缺乏情况征求第二意见。

entries.en: The jeweller returned the achroite after noticing a scratch that had not appeared in the photograph.
entries.zh: 珠宝商发现一处照片中未显示的划痕后，退回了那块无色电气石。

entries.en: The old chart placed Achromatiaceae beside another family, but its explanatory pages were missing.
entries.zh: 旧图表把无色杆菌科列在另一个科旁边，但解释说明的几页材料缺失了。

entries.en: The photographs of Achromatium were replaced because several images had been assigned to the wrong specimens.
entries.zh: 无色杆菌属的那些照片被替换了，因为其中几张与标本对应错了。

entries.en: The drawing of an achromatocyte was returned to the illustrator because the scale was unclear.
entries.zh: 一幅无色红细胞图被退还给插画师，因为比例标示不清楚。

entries.en: The proposed evidence of achromatolysis could not be assessed from the blurred photographs.
entries.zh: 那些模糊照片无法用于评估所提出的胞质皱缩证据。

entries.en: The visitor with achromatopsia requested a version of the chart that did not rely on colour.
entries.zh: 那位全色盲参观者要求提供一个不依赖颜色的图表版本。

entries.en: The consultation about suspected achromatosis ended without a decision because the earlier photographs were unavailable.
entries.zh: 由于以前的照片无法提供，关于疑似色素缺乏的咨询结束时没有作出决定。

entries.en: The cultures of Achromobacter were excluded from the comparison after their records became mixed up.
entries.zh: 那些无色杆菌属培养物的记录混淆后，它们被排除在比较之外。

entries.en: The historian reconstructed the old classification of Achromobacteriaceae from several incomplete teaching charts.
entries.zh: 历史学者根据几张不完整的教学图表，重建了无色杆菌科的旧分类。

entries.meaningZh: 皮肤色素缺乏〔医学用语〕
entries.en: She asked for a private discussion of her suspected achromoderma before any photographs were taken.
entries.zh: 她要求在拍照之前，先私下讨论自己疑似的皮肤色素缺乏情况。

entries.en: An achromophil near the edge of the drawing had been omitted from the enlarged copy.
entries.zh: 放大副本漏画了原图边缘的一个不染体。

entries.en: The correspondence concerning achromoviromycin survived, although the research notebook it referred to did not.
entries.zh: 关于无色病毒素的往来信件保存了下来，但信中提到的研究笔记本没有。

entries.en: The proposed identification of achrooamyloid was disputed when the original slides could not be located.
entries.zh: 找不到原始载玻片后，所提出的无色淀粉样蛋白鉴定结论受到质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 淋巴细胞增多〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The recorded achroocytosis could not be reassessed because the dated blood-test results were missing.
entries.zh: 由于缺少注明日期的血液检查结果，记录中的淋巴细胞增多情况无法重新评估。

entries.en: A damaged page left the achroodextrin comparison unfinished in the surviving manuscript.
entries.zh: 留存手稿中的一页受损，使消色糊精的比较内容不完整。

entries.en: The recording in Achumawi was incomplete, so the translator asked for the missing section.
entries.zh: 那段阿库马维语录音不完整，因此译者要求提供缺失的部分。

entries.en: The old account of suspected achymosis contained no follow-up information about the patient.
entries.zh: 那份关于疑似食糜缺乏的旧记述，没有包含患者的后续信息。

entries.en: The achymous condition described in the old case history could not be independently reassessed.
entries.zh: 旧病历所描述的食糜缺乏状态，无法得到独立的重新评估。

entries.en: The proposed aci-compound was missing from the student's comparison of the two structural forms.
entries.zh: 学生比较那两种结构形式时，漏掉了所提出的酸式化合物。

entries.en: The archive retained an empty Aci-Jel carton with the pharmacist's correspondence.
entries.zh: 档案馆把一个Aci-Jel阿息胶空纸盒与药剂师的往来信件一起保存。

entries.en: The technician found that the replacement ACIA had been sent to a different workshop.
entries.zh: 技术人员发现，那个替换用的异步通信接口适配器被送到了另一个车间。

entries.en: An acid-anhydride had been included in the model set, but its identifying card was lost.
entries.zh: 模型组中原有一种酸酐，但标识卡丢失了。

entries.en: The disputed material could not be identified as an acid-carbonate from the surviving measurements alone.
entries.zh: 仅凭留存的测量数据，无法把争议材料鉴定为一种酸性碳酸盐。

entries.en: She chose acid-free paper for the drawings she hoped to leave to her grandchildren.
entries.zh: 她为那些希望留给孙辈的画选用了无酸纸。

entries.en: The proposed purchase of acid-fuchsin was cancelled when the class changed its project.
entries.zh: 班级改变项目后，拟议的酸性品红采购被取消了。

entries.en: The old case of suspected acid-intoxication could not be reassessed without the missing test records.
entries.zh: 没有那些缺失的检测记录，就无法重新评估旧病历中疑似的酸中毒病例。

entries.en: The disputed acid-producing material was excluded from the mining report until its identity was checked.
entries.zh: 那份身份存在争议的生酸材料，在核实之前被排除在采矿报告之外。

entries.en: The supplier could not confirm whether the replacement lining was acid-proof.
entries.zh: 供应商无法确认替换用的衬里是否耐酸。

entries.en: The comparison of the first acidaffin fraction was omitted from the revised manuscript.
entries.zh: 修订后的手稿漏掉了第一亲酸物组分的比较内容。

entries.en: The comparison of acidalbumin was interrupted when the instrument's records became unreadable.
entries.zh: 仪器记录变得无法读取，酸白蛋白的比较工作因此中断。

entries.en: The recorded acidalbuminuria was questioned after the laboratory discovered that two samples had been confused.
entries.zh: 实验室发现两个样品混淆后，记录中的酸白蛋白尿情况受到质疑。

entries.en: The student had included an acidamide in the comparison but could not explain the accompanying diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在比较中纳入了一种酰胺，却解释不了随附的图。

entries.en: The images of Acidaminococcus were excluded from the comparison because their original records were missing.
entries.zh: 由于缺少原始记录，那些氨基酸球菌属图像未被纳入比较。

entries.en: The family requested an interpreter before the appointment concerning the suspected acidaminuria.
entries.zh: 在就疑似氨基酸尿情况就诊之前，家属要求安排口译员。

entries.en: The gardener found an acidanthera growing where she had planned to put the new bench.
entries.zh: 园丁发现，在原打算安放新长凳的地方长着一株非洲鸢尾。

entries.en: The account of acidation ended abruptly where a page had been torn from the notebook.
entries.zh: 关于酸化的记述在笔记本一页被撕去的地方戛然而止。

entries.en: The acidfast bacilli in the teaching photograph were difficult to distinguish from the background.
entries.zh: 教学照片中的那些抗酸杆菌，很难与背景区分开来。

entries.en: The novel's acidhead narrator becomes less reliable as his friendship with the painter deteriorates.
entries.zh: 随着与画家的友谊恶化，小说中那位嗜用LSD的叙述者变得越来越不可靠。

entries.en: The acidifiable material was absent from the comparison set delivered to the classroom.
entries.zh: 送到教室的比较组中，缺少了那种可酸化的材料。

entries.en: The acidific stage of the proposed process was omitted from the cost estimate.
entries.zh: 成本估算漏计了拟议工艺中酸化阶段的费用。

entries.en: The acidimeter was moved to a lower shelf after its display case was damaged.
entries.zh: 展柜损坏后，那台酸比重计被移到了一个较低的搁架上。

entries.en: The physician could not confirm the reported acidism without seeing the earlier records.
entries.zh: 没有看到以前的记录，医生无法确认所报告的酸中毒情况。

entries.en: The old report of acidismus contained no reliable account of the circumstances preceding the illness.
entries.zh: 那份关于酸类中毒的旧报告，没有可靠地记述发病前的情况。

entries.en: The acidless solution was included in the comparison, but its measurements were accidentally omitted.
entries.zh: 比较中纳入了那份无酸溶液，但它的测量数据被意外漏掉了。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜酸白细胞增多〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The suspected acidocytosis was discussed again after the missing blood-test results were found.
entries.zh: 丢失的血液检查结果找回后，疑似的嗜酸白细胞增多情况再次被拿来讨论。

entries.en: The reported acidogenic activity could not be confirmed from the incomplete observations.
entries.zh: 不完整的观察记录无法证实所报告的产酸活性。

entries.en: The seminar's disputed acidoglycoprotein measurements prompted requests for a clearer comparison chart.
entries.zh: 研讨会上的酸性糖蛋白测量数据存在争议，促使与会者要求提供更清楚的比较图表。

entries.en: The claimed change in acidohydrogenase activity remained uncertain after the original files were lost.
entries.zh: 原始文件丢失后，所声称的酸脱氢酶活性变化仍无法确定。

entries.en: The proposed acidoid material was removed from the comparison when its identity became doubtful.
entries.zh: 那份拟议的似酸材料身份变得可疑后，被从比较中移除了。

entries.en: The cracked acidometer was kept for the museum's records rather than returned to use.
entries.zh: 那台有裂纹的酸度计被保留下来供博物馆存档，而没有重新投入使用。

entries.en: Her comparison of two accounts of acidometry was interrupted by the library's closing announcement.
entries.zh: 图书馆的闭馆通知，打断了她对两份酸定量法记述的比较。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜酸白细胞减少〔医学用语〕
entries.en: The appointment concerning suspected acidopenia was postponed when the interpreter became unavailable.
entries.zh: 口译员无法到场后，针对疑似嗜酸白细胞减少安排的门诊被推迟了。

entries.en: The research group's disagreement over acidophilin remained unresolved when its funding ended.
entries.zh: 研究小组的经费结束时，关于嗜酸菌素的分歧仍未解决。

entries.en: An acidoproteolyte was included in the proposed comparison, but the observation records were incomplete.
entries.zh: 拟议的比较中纳入了一种蛋白酸解菌，但观察记录不完整。

entries.en: The supposedly acidoproteolytic strain was excluded because its identification could not be checked.
entries.zh: 那株据称能生酸并分解蛋白质的菌株被排除了，因为无法核查其鉴定结果。

entries.en: The acidosic condition described in the summary was disputed after the original records were examined.
entries.zh: 查阅原始记录后，摘要中所描述的酸中毒状态受到质疑。
